title: 2026-11-06 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding (ScitiX.AI, 屏障比传输更贵：让数据块自带就绪证据，8 卡 B300 上 all-reduce 延迟降 28.8%。)、Runway Characters: Serving a 57B Video Diffusion Transformer for Real-Time Conversation (Runway, 57B 视频 DiT 单用户 24fps：把全 cache 读时工作搬到写时 + all-reduce 融进 FP8 GEMM。)、vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference (Tsinghua University, 全冗余虚拟化专家存储 + H2D/PCIe 争用建模，DeepSeek-V3.1 八节点 H100 上 1.2 倍加速。)

highlights.name: flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding
highlights.note: 屏障比传输更贵：让数据块自带就绪证据，8 卡 B300 上 all-reduce 延迟降 28.8%。

highlights.name: Hybrid Spark: Adaptive Speculative Decoding That Lets the Content Choose the Drafter
highlights.note: 两种 drafter 同跑并对验证槽位定价：代码编辑吞吐 +10~62%，对话几乎零损失。

highlights.name: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
highlights.note: 把 gated delta 注意力按 TPU 脉动阵列重塑：单层快 1.6~2.5 倍，2048 卡预训练快 11~24%。
